question.worked_solution:
First, we isolate the absolute value on the left side of the equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}|1-2x|-2 & =7 \\ |1-2x| & =9\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we have the following two cases:

- If $|1-2x|=1-2x,$ we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}|1-2x| & =9 \\ 1-2x & =9 \\ -2x & =8 \\ x & =-4\end{aligned}
$$

- If $|1-2x|=-(1-2x),$ we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}|1-2x| & =9 \\ -(1-2x) & =9 \\ -1+2x & =9 \\ 2x & =10 \\ x & =5\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, in ascending order, the solutions are $x=-4$ and $x=5.$
